This '''species''' was a bipedal [[humanoid]] [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] that existed in [[the galaxy]]. They were distinguished by their [[Color|pale]] skin, as well as a pair of fin-like growths on the upper sides of their head and four pointed barbs extending from their face.<ref name="BOBF1" /> In [[9 ABY]],<ref name="Date">{{BoBFDate}}</ref> at least one member of this species visited [[Garsa Fwip's Sanctuary]] in [[Mos Espa]] on the [[planet]] [[Tatooine]].<ref name="BOBF1" />

{{Species-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
This species first appeared in the [[Chapter 1: Stranger in a Strange Land|first episode]] of the television series, ''[[Star Wars: The Book of Boba Fett]],'' written by [[Jon Favreau]] and directed by [[Robert Rodriguez]].<ref name="BOBF1" /> The species shared many traits with [[Unidentified barbed green species|another species]] created for the [[Chapter 9: The Marshal|first episode]] of the [[The Mandalorian Season Two|second season]] of the television series, ''[[Star Wars: The Mandalorian]],''<ref name="Mando9">{{TheMandalorian|Chapter 9: The Marshal}}</ref> referred to behind the scenes by makeup artist [[Brian Sipe]] and team simply by the nickname "Catfish."<ref name="Gallery">{{DisneyGallery|Disney Gallery: The Mandalorian: Making of Season Two|Making of Season Two}}</ref>
